counterexample: Observed bounded fixture from reproduce_restart.py: a Node HTTP server installs process.on("SIGTERM",()=>{}), keeps PID 7 answering port 3000, and ignores the helper termination. Current helper returns 0 after spawning PID 67, although PID 67 fails EADDRINUSE and requests still reach PID 7. Extending that same server with an in-memory snippet map can falsely satisfy post-restart readback because no process replacement occurred. Separately, the same surviving original child without invoking restart makes cleanup at test.sh:37 wait indefinitely; that cleanup behavior is a source-derived witness, not a measured run.
